entries.title: Reviewer Passes
entries.compatibility: A skipped credit-capable quota probe records quota-probe-unavailable, probe-error and quotaExhaustedSkip=false in existing metadata. Hard attempt accounting also recognizes older skips with the paired probe state and reason.

entries.title: Reviewer Cascade State
entries.compatibility: Additive quota-probe-unavailable failure class. Existing backoff fields identify the selected family and carry the ordinary exponential deadline without a provider reset.
